patch.objective: Resilience and recovery: high availability (load balancing vs. clustering), site considerations (hot, cold, warm, geographic dispersion), platform diversity, multi-cloud systems, continuity of operations, capacity planning (people, technology, infrastructure); testing (tabletop exercises, fail over, simulation, parallel processing); backups (onsite/offsite, frequency, encryption, snapshots, recovery, replication, journaling); power (generators, uninterruptible power supply (UPS))

sources.cite: CompTIA Security+ (V7), exam SY0-701: domains General security concepts 12%, Threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigations 22%, Security architecture 18%, Security operations 28%, Security program management and oversight 20%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-16 for this Security+ band. The page lists the five domains and weights above, says English SY0-701 retires on June 11, 2027, and describes the topics: resilience and recovery (high availability, site considerations, testing, power, platform diversity, backups, continuity of operations); third-party risk (vendor assessment, selection, agreements, monitoring, questionnaires, rules of engagement); network attacks among the malicious activities; alerting and monitoring. The objectives PDF was not re-read; the objective wording is the course seed's.

Read 2026-11-14 through a summarizing fetch. Relevant text: 'Maintain offline, encrypted backups of critical data, and regularly test the availability and integrity of backups'; 'Some cloud vendors offer immutable storage solutions that can protect stored data'; 'Determine which systems were impacted, and immediately isolate them'; 'If several systems or subnets appear impacted, take the network offline at the switch level.'
